findings.rationale: Not a dead import: hooks/session-start.js still calls crypto.createHash at lines 337, 373 and 507 (handoff body claim, gen check, intent cwdHash), and hooks/session-handoff.js at line 333 (the gen digest). Only the /clear key hash moved into clearHandoffKey.

By design: verify-red-green.sh records the verify script's sha256 and argv, which is what makes the receipt checkable; the P1 and P2 receipts carry the same scratchpad path, and the plan does not require the verify script to be committed. The test it runs (hooks/tests/stage-advance.test.sh) is committed and named in red_tests.
